name: tutorial_race_setup
comment: (0..2) one of the three tutorial races (career mode 2; car 5 with fixed upgrades; route 1 or 3); picks opponents

name: fill_rect8
comment: (rect x0 y0 x1 y1; page; pitch; colour x 0x01010101) fills a rectangle of an 8bpp page (byte stores at odd edges)

name: text_box
comment: (font; text key or pointer; x; y; width; lines; colour) text in a box through FUN_08162B6C; key per language table

name: fill_bg_palette
comment: (start; colour; count) BG palette entries from start set to colour

name: scale_obj_palette
comment: (source; r; g; b; first; n) OBJ palette entries = source channels x factor / 256 capped at 31

name: menu_scene_teardown
comment: every menu kind's exit handler: FUN_08139B7C(world)

name: garage_copy_car_record
comment: copies the car record of 0x03005718: bytes 0..6 to 0x03005700 and 7..16 to 0x03005707

name: unlock_state
comment: (tentative; stub in menu.rs) (unlock id) 1 owned; 2 locked; 0 or 3 not affordable: drives the car-select and crew prompts

name: buy_unlock
comment: (tentative; stub) (unlock id) buys a car after the confirmed message box

name: unlock_owned
comment: (tentative; stub) (unlock id) nonzero when owned (car select shows no price)

name: list_item_new
comment: (tentative; stub) (screen; item) nonzero: the item gets a "new" mark

name: upgrades_changed
comment: (tentative; stub) (not the performance page) nonzero when the upgrades changed (0x03005954; save question 0x376)

name: car_stats_draw
comment: (tentative; stub) (car; x; y; 0) the car-select stat bars

name: orient_upright
comment: body upright at a 14-bit heading (low 2 bits dropped): quaternion via matrix_to_quat renormalised through the reciprocal table; rotation matrix; momenta kept (car_put_back_on_road; body_init)

name: traffic_spawner_behind
comment: spawner entity (state 0 -> 1): while traffic is under its limit and the camera car within *0x03006258: counts +0xA0 down and spawns traffic kind 0 (section start; half speed)

name: traffic_spawner_ahead
comment: as traffic_spawner_behind with traffic kind 2 (section start; full speed)

name: spawner_handlers
comment: (tentative) entity handler 0x28; the thunks 0x0814A9C0 (0x2A: traffic_spawner_ahead) and 0x0814A9D4/0x0814A9E0 (0x2D/0x2E: traffic_spawner_behind) sit inside it; no Carbon race creates such entities

name: non_racer_car_hit
comment: car-to-car hit of a non-racer: when 0x03006174 is set and it is not the first entity the other car's +0x4B8 = 0x40; clears 0x030061F0

name: unlock_table_index
comment: row of an unlock id in the 0x7E4DE4 (id; price) table or -1; ported in nfsgba-formats unlock.rs

name: unlock_id_adjust
comment: (id; car index at 0x03005718) ids 0xA1..0xA3 shifted by the sum of the first car-index slot bytes at 0x7F0626 minus the index; ported in unlock.rs

name: unlock_group
comment: 1..10 for the group-leader ids 0xC 0x19 0x26 0x33 0x40 0x4D 0x5A 0x67 0x70 0x78 else 0; ported in unlock.rs

name: vcount_irq_on
comment: sets the sky gradient start 0x030056E8 = *0x030053B8 and DISPSTAT bit 5 (VCount IRQ) on; the counterpart of vcount_irq_off (0x0813a4e0); called at the end of race_menu_palette_setup outside race game state 5

name: menu_scene_free
comment: frees the scene's heap blocks (0x03005FB4/0x03005FB8 and world +0x1C +0x18 +0x48 +0x0C +0x68 +0x64 +0x6C +0x60 +0xFC +0x44 +0x40 ...) the same list as race_cleanup; menu_scene_teardown (0x081372d8) is a thin wrapper
